sentences.japanese: 人生とは、他の予定を立てることに忙しくしている時に起こる現象のことだ。
sentences.english: Life is what happens to you while you're busy making other plans.

sentences.japanese: 君は忙しい人なのだから、私が君の予定に合わせます。
sentences.english: You are a busy man, so I will adjust myself to your schedule.

sentences.japanese: 君はいつも蜜蜂のように忙しくしているね。
sentences.english: You are always as busy as a bee.

sentences.japanese: 君に手紙を書くつもりだったんだが、忙しすぎてね。
sentences.english: I was going to write to you, but I was too busy.

sentences.japanese: 忙しければ、私が手伝います。
sentences.english: If you're busy, I'll help you.
